neighbours.label: the intensifier ' very' (and 'much', 'well') before an adjective or adverb
fire: The hotel staff were very friendly during our stay.
This phone gives very good battery life for the price.
Her latest novel is very different from the first one.
The trail gets very steep after the second bridge.
We found the instructions very easy to follow.
The soup was very hot, so we waited a minute.
Our new neighbours seem very quiet and polite.
The test was very hard for most of the class.
quiet: The hotel staff were friendly during our stay.
This phone gives good battery life for the price.
Her latest novel is different from the first one.
The trail gets steeper after the second bridge.
We found the instructions easy enough to follow.
The soup was hot, so we waited a minute.
Our new neighbours seem quiet and polite.
The test was hard for most of the class.

notes: ' very' x11, ' much' x6 among top 32
